title: Mystic Orb and Teardrop
description: A large circular golden frame with ornate geometric patterns encloses a surreal painted landscape featuring a castle, winding river, and geometric grid overlay. A black teardrop-shaped pendant with an eye and clock face floats beside it against a dark cosmic background with colorful paint splatters.
prompt: A large ornate circular golden frame floating in a dark cosmic space with colorful paint splatters, inside the frame is a surreal painted landscape of a blue river winding through rocky terrain towards a distant castle under a geometric grid overlay with soft pastel clouds, beside the orb is a black glossy teardrop pendant containing a realistic eye and clock face with purple particle effects at the base, dramatic lighting, painterly style
